notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
If you were unable to create a new save file, that should now be fixed from the last patch.

And there was a visual issue with the loot screen where the equipment wouldn't display which is now fixed.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and More Tutorials
notes.notes:
Important
- the next note after pausing is no longer stacked on top of another note
- windowed mode is now always 16:9, fullscreen should look better for widescreen users too

A NEW STAT
- the adrenaline stat is back from older versions of the game. it is only found on the floor6 boss unique and it's explanation can be found in the help menu under the nature boss/unique tab including math

TUTORIALS
- various stats are now explained (with math) under the first tab in the help page that weren't explained before. these stats exclude unique-exclusive stats and weakness stats
- powerlevel math is now explained under the equipment help menu tab
- weakness math is now explained under the weakness tab in the help menu
- accuracy stat and math are now explained under the uniques that provide them
- there is now a WASD to move minitutorial on new save creation
- there is now a dungeon splits minitutorial on new save creation

Fixes
- hitting save in settings brings you to the main menu if you were in the main menu, and dungeon if you were in the dungeon
- fixed various issues with the floor changing arrows
- ensured the player cannot move while dungeon pop-up tutorials are visible

notes.title: Important Bug Fixes, Volume Changes, and Balancing Patch
notes.notes:
Important
- loot screen should always come up after winning a battle, this caused a rare softlock before
- enemy max per floor was broken so it should be much better now

Volume Changes
- there is now a settings button on the main menu screen instead of just inside the dungeon ui
- volume setting is now properly perceived linear
- changing volume is now instantly saved
- volume now changes properly even while music is fading in
- battle hit, misses, and quarter warnings sfx are now affected by volume
- layered transition sfx are now affected by volume

Gameplay
- removed half notes and dodge notes from floor 3 boss cause "you made it too hard" and "its the hardest boss in the game"
- vitality is very nerfed as it was too op but its still really good ngl so play around with it
- accuracy is now a stat on two uniques, this increases the hit area
- snake now properly displays in collection log
- removed half notes from the final boss
- on zoom in, enemies no longer disappear

Other
- steam cloud saving is now supported
- steam db now owns a key
- lowered polish and swiss price against steam's recommendation

notes.title: Important Patch
notes.notes:
Important
- Fixed volume issues: if you were experiencing things like music being quiet while hit sfx being loud, then mess with the volume bar in settings and that should fix it. For everyone else just starting the game, then it should be fixed already

- Known bug: the next note is stacked on top of each other after you pause and resume during battle. This isn't fixed but it's on the list

Other Changes
- Kills required for a lich gem charge increased from 8 -> 13

- Increased halfnote warning sound effect volume

- Discord rich presence is now compatible

notes.title: Demo Update 2.1 & Announcement
notes.notes:
Update 2.1
This update changes so many things that I'm not even going to bother typing it all out because you probably won't notice most of them anyway.

What you will notice is the new combat UI and the new monster sprites. I have gotten some help from a couple pixel artists and I worked hard implementing them. We are redoing all the monster sprites and all of the enemies that you see in the demo should be updated.

The Demo's Future
The demo will not be here forever. Sometime after Steam Next Fest 2024 I will be removing the demo. I don't think that it provides a good enough understanding of the game by just playing the first 3 floors. There is more to it than even just that but that's the important part. If you haven't had the chance, play it while it lasts.

I'm really excited to finish this game and am grateful for the recent help I have received.

/@<3

notes.title: Demo Update 1.3: Windows & Mac
notes.notes:
What's Next?
The last update will be mostly full of cosmetic and small changes that don't affect gameplay too much. But there is one feature I will be adding in the last update that is fairly important and that is a save system for while you are in the middle of a dungeon.

Right now, if you were to save the game in the middle of a dungeon and close the game, upon reopening it would just regenerate the floor that you were previously on. I will be implementing a save system that will keep track of the floor generation including enemies and the boss.

This way you can tackle the boss as many times as you want while being able to take a break between fights.
-------------------------
Mac Support
All previous updates and changes made in this update are in the mac version right now

Data

Fixed the bug that randomly deleted your save file


Battle

Fixed player randomly taking damage at the start of the next battle after ending a battle with a dodge incoming
Fixed score displaying incorrectly at times
Last update I said that you can no longer get a dodge on your 2nd bar, but I think it is actually true now
Changed monster countdown from 3210 to 1234
Fixed issue I caused in one of the last updates that made the boss sprite change to a spider during healthbar regenerate animations
Fixed issue I caused in one of the last updates where after the boss gets to 0 hp, you had to attack again to trigger the boss' death
Boss new HP bar animation now lines up with the SFX better
First bar during countdown is now green not white


UI

Fixed inventory item stacking bug when trying to swap multiple items continuously
Boss name now fits in collection log
On the loot screen's collection log, it now just says "Monster" instead of naming the current monster.(the monster name can still be found in the collection log on the dungeon screen)
The "floor" collection log on the loot screen is now /12 if there is a boss on that floor and it adds the boss' collected items to the total
Made WASD visuals go default during countdown
If the boss is selected in the collection log and you press travel, the button is now properly highlighted
Dungeon rooms and hallways now go behind the collection log UI on zoom in/monster encounter
Iron full helm now has the correct sprite in the inventory instead of an iron med helm


Tutorial

During the dodge tutorial:

there is no longer a second dodge-bar after you successfully dodge
dodges properly flip-flop until you successfully dodge
dodge indicator is now always correct

Tutorial no longer freezes are finishing, and I removed the fade transition after finishing the tutorial (this may have not been the case for previous patches)
Loot tutorial no longer requires you to equip your sword loot instead of just taking it into your inventory (this may have not been the case for previous patches)


Items

Got rid of speed effect on weapons so bows instead of being +Speed, -Strength; are now: +Vitality, -Crit Strength; Also changed values to +%15, -%5 while all other weapon positive and negative effects are %10


Sound

The keyboard pressing SFX now triggers for all key presses and releases instead of just WASD
